about_the_game:
Embark on a journey as Menes, a celestial being without memory, sent into a forsaken realm to free a mysterious prisoner. Nothing is as it seems — ancient powers stir, shadows whisper forgotten truths, and your very identity may be the key to salvation… or ruin.

Uncover dark secrets, explore temples and dimensions, and confront enemies drawn from corrupted echoes of Egyptian gods.

MENES blends intense platforming with the punishing challenges of a souls-like adventure, drawing inspiration from cult classics like Soul Reaver. This is not just a quest — it's a test of memory, identity, and fate.

🔥Key Features:

- Challenging Platformer Combat: Precision-based movements and deadly encounters await.

- Epic Boss Fights: Face ancients that are both prisoners and jailers, fallen gods and angels. Uncover their tragic stories!

- Lore-Rich World: Uncover hidden truths in cryptic murals, echoing voices, and twisted mazes.

- Haunting and Memorable Art: A surreal aesthetic will immerse you fully.

- Souls-like Progression: Learn from every death as you grow stronger and reach your true potential.

Will you survive the trials and discover the truth about the origins, or will you fall to the shadows lurking in the desert and beyond?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4570 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470, 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX Vega 56, 8 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: As Menes, a forgotten celestial, you awaken in a dying realm. Sent to free an ancient prisoner, you’ll face corrupted gods, cryptic truths, and a fate darker than death. A platformer adventure with very similar vibes to Soul Reaver awaits you!
